newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Wal-Mart Brazil sees 1998 profit - report.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart Brazil sees 1998 profit - report.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc Brazilian unit does not expect to post profits before 1998, after an expansion of the number of shopping malls in the country, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reported.

It said the company plans to invest $200 million to open 10 to 12 new malls in Brazil by the end of next year. Currently, the company has five units in Brazil -- two Supercenters and three Sam's clubs.

Wal-Mart Brasil, which is a joint-venture between Wal-Mart Stores Inc and Brazil's Lojas Americanas, posted losses of 31.5 million reais between May 1995, when it inaugurated its first mall in Brazil, and June 1996, Gazeta said.
